description.narrative: The objective of the consultancy assignment is to support MFA (LÆRING) in drafting an independent appraisal of the Programme Document for the permanent Development Guarantee Facility including all relevant supporting documentation and assess if it is fit to underpin programme implementation and produce the expected results in an effective, efficient and sustainable manner in compliance with the OECD-DAC criteria and principles and rules of Danida policies and Aid Management Guidelines. The appraisal will critically assess the readiness of IFDK to manage a sovereign liability portfolio independently of Sida. This includes a rigorous validation of the proposed risk capital model, the internal separation of duties (origination vs. risk assessment), and the facility's ability to ensure genuine financial and development additionality in line with OECD-DAC principles
